mapper.select: /* adpt.select_API_DEF_with_API_SPC */ SELECT A.API_NO ,A.API_SPC_NO ,A.API_NM ,A.API_CTGRY_NO ,A.API_PATH ,A.METHOD_CD ,COALESCE(B.CD_NM,'') AS METHOD_CD_NM ,A.API_ID ,A.API_DESC ,TO_CHAR(A.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT ,A.REGR ,TO_CHAR(A.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AMD_DT ,A.SORT_ODRG ,A.SHOW_STATUS_CD ,A.USE_YN ,A.API_GUBUN ,A.API_HANDLER_CD ,COALESCE(C.CD_NM,'') AS API_HANDLER_CD_NM ,A.ENDPNT_METHOD_CD ,COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS ENDPNT_METHOD_CD_NM ,A.ENDPNT_TB_URL ,A.ENDPNT_PRD_URL ,COALESCE(A.ENDPNT_TIMEOUT, 0) AS ENDPNT_TIMEOUT ,A.ENDPNT_CLIENT_IP ,A.RESMAP_RES_CD_FIELD ,A.RESMAP_SUCC_VAL ,A.RESMAP_ERR_CD_FIELD ,A.RESMAP_ERR_MSG_FIELD ,A.HDP_API_OUT_FORMAT ,A.HDP_API_OUT_COMMON_PARAM ,A.HDP_API_ENDPOINT_ID ,A.HDP_REQ_API_NAME ,A.HDP_REQ_CONFIG_TO_BODY ,A.HDP_REQ_HEADER_TO_BODY ,A.HDP_REQ_MAPPING_TO_BODY ,A.HDP_REQ_URL_DECODE ,A.HDP_REQ_URL_ENCODE ,A.HDP_RES_MAPPING_TO_BODY ,A.HDP_RES_PROVIDE_PARAM ,A.HDP_RES_URL_ENCODE ,A.HDP_EXT_PROP ,A.HDP_HNDLROPTN_CONFIG ,A.API_VER ,A.API_VER_NO ,A.BSTGW_TB_SYS_ID ,COALESCE((SELECT sub.SYS_NM FROM BST_SYNC_TB_ADM_SYS_DPLY sub WHERE (sub.SYS_ID = A.BSTGW_TB_SYS_ID)), '') AS BSTGW_TB_SYS_NM ,A.BSTGW_PRD_SYS_ID ,COALESCE((SELECT sub.SYS_NM FROM BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY sub WHERE (sub.SYS_ID = A.BSTGW_PRD_SYS_ID)), '') AS BSTGW_PRD_SYS_NM ,A.DPLY_REQ_FLAG ,TO_CHAR(A.DPLY_REQ_FLAG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DPLY_REQ_FLAG_DATE ,A.TB_DPLY_STATUS ,TO_CHAR(A.TB_DPLY_STATUS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TB_DPLY_STATUS_DATE ,A.DPLY_VERI_STATUS ,TO_CHAR(A.DPLY_VERI_STATUS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DPLY_VERI_STATUS_DATE ,A.PRD_DPLY_REQ_FLAG ,TO_CHAR(A.PRD_DPLY_REQ_FLAG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PRD_DPLY_REQ_FLAG ,A.PRD_DPLY_STATUS ,TO_CHAR(A.PRD_DPLY_STATUS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PRD_DPLY_STATUS_DATE ,S.API_SPC_ID AS spc_API_SPC_ID ,S.VER AS spc_VER ,S.API_NM AS spc_API_NM ,S.API_DESC AS spc_API_DESC ,S.AUT_ID AS spc_AUT_ID ,S.SYS_ID AS spc_SYS_ID ,COALESCE(E.SYS_NM,'') AS SYS_ID_NM ,S.VER_DESC AS spc_VER_DESC ,S.RFRN_WSDL_URL AS spc_RFRN_WSDL_URL ,S.RFRN_TMPLT_NO AS spc_RFRN_TMPLT_NO ,S.RFRN_API_SPC_NO AS spc_RFRN_API_SPC_NO ,S.HOST AS spc_HOST ,S.BAS_PATH AS spc_BAS_PATH ,S.YAML_FILE_PATH AS spc_YAML_FILE_PATH ,S.YAML_FILE_NM AS spc_YAML_FILE_NM ,S.REG_STTUS_CD AS spc_REG_STTUS_CD ,TO_CHAR(S.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS spc_REG_DT ,S.REGR AS spc_REGR ,TO_CHAR(S.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS spc_AMD_DT ,S.YAML_SBST AS spc_YAML_SBST ,S.API_CLASS AS spc_API_CLASS ,S.BSTGW_YN AS spc_BSTGW_YN ,S.API_VERI_BASEURL AS spc_API_VERI_BASEURL FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC S ON (S.API_SPC_NO = A.API_SPC_NO) AND (S.DEL_YN = 'N') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD B ON (B.COMN_CD = A.METHOD_CD AND B.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD C ON (C.COMN_CD = A.API_HANDLER_CD AND C.GROUP_CD = 'APIHDR1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (D.COMN_CD = A.ENDPNT_METHOD_CD AND D.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM E ON (E.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID) WHERE (A.API_NO = #{apiNo})

/* adpt.select_API_TESTCASE */ SELECT T.TESTCASE_ID ,T.API_NO ,T.TESTCASE_NM ,T.PARAM_GUB ,T.PARAM_HEADER ,T.PARAM_BODY ,T.PARAM_QUERY ,T.PARAM_HEADER_JSON ,T.PARAM_BODY_JSON ,T.ASSERT_CASE ,T.ASSERT_FIELD ,T.ASSERT_OPERATOR ,T.ASSERT_VALUE ,T.INFOVIEW_YN ,TO_CHAR(T.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT ,TO_CHAR(T.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AMD_DT ,D.API_NO AS def_API_NO ,D.API_NM AS def_API_NM ,COALESCE(B1.CD_NM, 0) AS def_API_HANDLER_CD_NM FROM KOA_TB_API_TESTCASE T INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF D ON (D.API_NO = T.API_NO) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD B1 ON (B1.COMN_CD = D.API_HANDLER_CD AND B1.GROUP_CD = 'APIHDR1000') WHERE (T.DEL_YN = 'N')
AND (T.API_NO = #{apiNo})
AND (T.TESTCASE_ID = #{testcaseId})
ORDER BY T.AMD_DT DESC, T.TESTCASE_ID DESC

/* adpt.select_API_VERI_CONDITION */ SELECT V.SEQ ,V.DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ ,V.TEST_CASE_SEQ ,TO_CHAR(V.VERIFICATION_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS VERIFICATION_DT ,V.RESULT_CD ,V.RESULT_MSG ,V.VERIFI_USR ,V.SUCCESS_YN ,V.ST_TIME ,V.END_TIME ,V.PROC_RESULT_CD ,V.PROC_RESULT_MSG ,V.REQ_GW_PROFILE ,V.REQ_API_VERI_BASEURL ,V.REQ_API_URL ,V.REQ_HEADERS ,V.REQ_BODY ,V.REQ_TRANSACTION_ID ,V.REQ_SEQUENCE_NO ,V.RES_TRANSACTION_ID ,V.RES_SEQUENCE_NO ,V.RES_RETURN_CODE ,V.RES_RETURN_DESCRIPTION ,V.RES_ERROR_CODE ,V.RES_ERROR_DESCRIPTION ,V.RES_RESPONSE ,V.API_NO ,V.API_NM ,V.TESTCASE_NM ,V.PARAM_GUB ,V.PARAM_HEADER ,V.PARAM_BODY ,V.PARAM_QUERY ,V.PARAM_HEADER_JSON ,V.PARAM_BODY_JSON ,V.ASSERT_CASE ,V.ASSERT_FIELD ,V.ASSERT_OPERATOR ,V.ASSERT_VALUE ,V.ASSERT_RESULT FROM KOA_TB_API_VERI_CONDITION V WHERE (V.SEQ = #{seq})

/* adpt.select_NEXT_API_ID*/ SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT (SUBSTRING(MAX(API_ID), 1, 5) || RIGHT('0000' || CAST((CAST(SUBSTRING(MAX(API_ID), 6, 4) AS INTEGER) + 1) AS VARCHAR), 4)) FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE (API_ID LIKE (#{prefix} + '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'))) , (#{prefix} + '0001')) AS NEXT_API_ID

/* adpt.select_NEXT_API_ID_INFO */ SELECT PREFIX_API_ID AS prefix , MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen}) AS INTEGER)) AS curMinId , MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen}) AS INTEGER)) AS curMaxId
, COALESCE((SELECT MIN_ID::INTEGER FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM WHERE (SYS_ID = #{sysId}) AND (MIN_ID ~ '^\d+$') AND (MAX_ID ~ '^\d+$')), -999) AS sysMinId , COALESCE((SELECT MAX_ID::INTEGER FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM WHERE (SYS_ID = #{sysId}) AND (MIN_ID ~ '^\d+$') AND (MAX_ID ~ '^\d+$')), -999) AS sysMaxId
FROM ( SELECT sub.API_ID , LEFT(sub.API_ID, LENGTH('' + #{prefix})) AS PREFIX_API_ID FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF sub ) tab WHERE (PREFIX_API_ID = #{prefix}) AND (SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen}) ~ '^\d+$')
AND (SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen})::INTEGER >= #{minId})
AND (SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen})::INTEGER <= #{maxId})
GROUP BY PREFIX_API_ID

/* adpt.select_DEPLOY_PROC */ SELECT D.API_NO ,D.DEPLOY_CD ,D.VERIFI_CD ,TO_CHAR(D.DEPLOY_ST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DEPLOY_ST_DT FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC D WHERE (D.API_NO = #{apiNo}) ORDER BY D.DEPLOY_ST_DT DESC, SEQ DESC
LIMIT #{top}
